Mourinho criticizes referee after Real Madrid's derby loss

Jose Mourinho expressed anger at the refereeing during the Madrid derby, which Real Madrid lost 2-1 to Atletico Madrid. Mourinho used images of tackles to illustrate his point about officials losing control. Real Madrid issued a statement following the match.
